description: This file defines the LogNode interface for a logging system, specifying a contract for implementing classes to output log messages. It includes documentation explaining its purpose and the println method signature for logging messages with various parameters.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: An interface that specifies the logging behavior, requiring implementing classes to define how log messages are printed.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Method to output a log message, including priority, tag, message, and optional exception details.
